name: CtrlS Patna Edge DC 2 (Patliputra Industrial Area)
notes: CtrlS official page lists Patna Edge DC 2 at 1,670 racks / 11.6 MW IT load with 9-zone security. CtrlS acquired land in Patliputra Industrial Area (via BIADA, <300m from DC1) in Aug 2024 for a Rs 400 crore greenfield edge datacentre; completion/commissioning not yet confirmed by public sources, so status is construction (official listing + 2024 land acquisition).

name: Bihar State Data Centre 2.0 (BSDC 2.0)

notes: BSEDC official project page shows BSDC 2.0 in active/open state, running 4th year of O&M phase (i.e., operational, commissioned ~2022). No public MW capacity disclosed.
